name: Fidelidade - Companhia de Seguros
note: Fidelidade's own shareholders page lists Fosun International (through Millennium Gain Limited) at 84.9892% and Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD, the Portuguese state bank) at 15% as a strategic shareholder without control. Parent of hospital-da-luz (Luz Saude, where Fidelidade kept control after selling 40% to Macquarie Asset Management's MEIF 7 MED BIDCO, concluded 29 January 2026). Updated during the Casa Pia research (issue #390).
